nodes.label: shadcn registry preset b1tzNKAUa
nodes.rationale: Apply a single preset to change the visual theme, icon library, and font of the OneFlow frontend in one operation.

nodes.label: Request SQLModel (replaces PurchaseRequest)
nodes.rationale: Unify PurchaseRequest (internal transfer + vendor purchase) and MarketingRequest (customer dispatch) into a single Request entity with request_type discriminator.

nodes.label: Strangler Fig migration pattern
nodes.rationale: Old routers become thin shims that delegate to the new router logic so old URLs still work during migration window.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/requests/inbox (dept-targeted needs-action inbox)
nodes.rationale: The fulfilling department has no way to discover that an approved request is waiting for them. Sidebar red badge repointed to this dept-targeted count.

nodes.label: awaiting_signoff status (now activated)
nodes.rationale: Status already exists in the enum but is never set by any endpoint (dead status). Activated to bridge in_progress and received in the delivery-confirmation loop.

nodes.label: Cancel permission: admin only (at any active status)
nodes.rationale: User requirement: only admin can cancel. Previously requester-or-admin while pending.
nodes.norm_label: cancel permission: admin only (at any active status)

nodes.label: Merge RequestReceipt into Request (remove RequestReceipt entity)
nodes.rationale: RequestReceipt is a mostly-orphaned entity whose create endpoint is never called and whose permission plumbing is dead. Merging removes the dead subsystem.
nodes.norm_label: merge requestreceipt into request (remove requestreceipt entity)

nodes.label: GRN item click race bug (setTimeout onBlur)
nodes.rationale: setTimeout(setOpen(false), 150) in onBlur fires before onMouseDown's setOpen(false) propagates through React's batched update, closing the dropdown mid-selection.
